modelOverview: The Nautilus 5811/1G is Patek Philippe's white-gold successor to the discontinued 5711, launched in October 2022 as the simple time-and-date model in the collection. It reworks the classic Gerald Genta porthole design with a slightly enlarged 41mm two-part case and an integrated-looking bezel free of visible screws, echoing the original 1976 ref. 3700 'Jumbo'. It remains among the most sought-after references in the modern Nautilus line-up.

5811/1G-001.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 26-330 S C · 35–45h power reserve
5811/1G-001.materials: 18k white gold two-part case and integrated white gold bracelet with fold-over clasp
5811/1G-001.bezel: Integrated white gold bezel, brushed/polished porthole design, no visible screws
5811/1G-001.dial: Sunburst blue dial with black gradient rim, horizontally embossed, white gold baton markers and hands
5811/1G-001.description: The 5811/1G-001 is the flagship white-gold Nautilus that replaced the steel 5711 as the collection's standard time-and-date model, informally referred to by collectors as the modern 'Jumbo' Nautilus. It is fitted with the signature sunburst blue dial with a black gradient rim and runs the self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.White Gold – Blue Dial: 5811/1G-001 in 18k white gold on its integrated bracelet with the signature sunburst blue dial and black gradient rim, the standard-issue configuration for this reference.

5811/1G-011.movement: Automatic · Patek Philippe Calibre 26-330 S C · 35–45h power reserve
5811/1G-011.materials: 18k white gold two-part case and integrated white gold bracelet with fold-over clasp
5811/1G-011.bezel: Integrated white gold bezel, brushed/polished porthole design, no visible screws
5811/1G-011.dial: White dial variant of the 5811/1G, white gold baton markers and hands
5811/1G-011.description: The 5811/1G-011 shares the 41mm white-gold case, integrated bracelet and self-winding Calibre 26-330 S C of the standard 5811/1G-001 but is catalogued with a white dial rather than the sunburst blue of the -001. This dial variant is far less widely documented in press and retailer listings than the blue-dial version, so its exact dial finish has not been independently confirmed against a manufacturer source. Each example offered is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.

variants.White Gold – White Dial: 5811/1G-011 in 18k white gold on its integrated bracelet with a white dial, a rarer alternative to the standard sunburst blue 5811/1G-001.
